fact: The article, published 30 June 2026, states that Algeria's legal framework for AI is still under construction, with no specific regime and only indirect cover by general digital, data protection and cybercrime texts.
title: La régulation de l'intelligence artificielle en Algérie : entre innovation et encadrement juridique
publisher: Ziglôbitha, Revue des Arts, Linguistique, Littérature & Civilisations
